text:
jamie: Spun up a model-version comparison for v4-exp vs v3-stable, focused on per-worker kernel mix, batch shapes, and KV miss/evict signals. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/model-compare-v4v3

lee: saw a p99 uplift on /api/chat at ~13:22 UTC for v4-exp. p50 unchanged. p99 delta ~75ms vs v3. Not huge traffic but clear spike. :eyes:

anita: ran a quick stack-profile on the window. CLI notes:
```
$ rprof slice --model=v4-exp --from=13:15 --to=13:30
observations:
- kernel=fused-attn-q8 p50=9ms p95=17ms p99=110ms
- kernel=baseline-fp16 p50=12ms p95=20ms p99=28ms
- avg_batch_size fell 3.0 -> 1.3
- kv_miss_rate rose 0.6% -> 4.6%
- worker_hot_swap_count up slightly
```
Tail dominated by fused-attn q8 on specific workers — looks like more eviction/rebuilds.

matt: That matches the selector tweak we landed to prefer fused-attn-q8 for short sequences <128. It saves tokens on median but if a worker gets mixed short/long conversations it ends up rebuilding KV more. We need per-worker correlation: kernel_choice vs kv_miss vs token_latency.

pilar: Suggest augmenting the model-compare dashboard with: (1) stacked timeseries kernel_mix per-route, (2) worker heatmap of kv_miss_count, (3) avg_batch_size sparkline by route, (4) event annotations for kernel_selector version. I can prototype panels.

jamie: Good. Also we should emit a telemetry tag on request envelopes: kernel=NAME, seq_len, batch_size, worker_id, kv_event=(hit|miss|evict). That will make causal graphs easy.

raj: Plan:
- telemetry PR: emit kernel & kv_event tags in request envelope (sample line below)
- dashboard PR: add per-worker aggregation panels and an A/B comparison overlay (v4 vs v3)
- synthetic: run a traffic replay with prod seq distribution to reproduce deterministically
ETA telemetry PR 80m.

matt: sample log format we can emit now:
```
[telemetry] ts=2026-06-02T13:23:12Z model=v4-exp worker=us-west-2a kernel=fused-attn-q8 seq_len=48 batch_size=1 kv_event=miss token_ms=142
```
That will let us group by worker and kernel.

monitoring-bot: created alert model_compare.p99_delta > 40ms sustained 5m (channels: eng-runtime, eng-sre)

pilar: pushed panel prototypes to staging dashboard. linking RT-2021 with screenshot. The worker heatmap immediately shows two hosts with high kv_miss counts and heavy fused-attn usage.

anita: synthetic replay reproduced the p99 tail within 10m when we replayed mixed-session traffic. If we run a homogeneous short-seq replay the tail disappears. So interleaving is the trigger.

lee: holding v4-exp at 12% traffic pending telemetry. If p99 remains > baseline we stop the rollout.

matt: PR opened: github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/4589 — adds kernel tag + kv_event. Sample emitted lines look like the example above.

oscar: added a new dashboard panel: per-route kernel_kv_correlation. It overlays kernel_mix, kv_miss_rate, and avg_batch_size. In the v4 vs v3 overlay you can see kv_miss rate diverge as fused-attn usage increases.

jamie: nice. If we can show the causality we should do a targeted rollback of the selector change only, not the rest of v4. That minimizes churn.

raj: open question: should the kernel selector be KV-aware (i.e., bias toward kernels with lower rebuild cost when worker kv_miss_rate > threshold)? I think so. Also consider raising the flush window to allow slightly larger batches for short-seq workloads.

anita: experiment suggestion: add a small local instrumented run that forces the same request affinity to one worker vs random routing to demonstrate rebuild cost impact. Can do that in the synthetic harness.

deploy-bot: rollout v4-exp started 2026-06-02T13:00:00Z -> 12% traffic

lee: alert fired: model_compare.p99_delta > 40ms at 13:23 UTC. Pausing escalation while telemetry lands.

matt: merged telemetry PR into canary. Logs flowing. Example event lines show fused-attn-heavy hosts have kv_event=evict more often.

pilar: updated dashboard with per-worker annotations and an alert rule: worker_eviction_rate > 1% -> post in eng-runtime. Added runbook steps and a link to synth-run commands.

jamie: based on telemetry and synth we have clear chain: selector -> fused-attn dominant on mixed-affinity workers -> increased KV evictions -> token p99 tail. Let's do a targeted rollback of selector on the canary and keep other v4 changes.

deploy-bot: rollback selector-tweak on v4-exp -> complete 2026-06-02T13:41:15Z

monitoring-bot: alert resolved: p99 delta returned below threshold after rollback

lee: p99 back to baseline within ~5 minutes. Good signal.

jamie: action items captured in RT-2021:
- Make kernel selector KV-aware (priority)
- Add unit/integration tests using synthetic seq distributions
- Ship per-worker eviction heatmap + kernel annotations to prod dashboards
- Create an alert linking kernel_change tag to p99 deltas for faster triage

sre-bot: incident closed. root cause: kernel selector change interacting with request routing -> KV thrash and p99 tail. Mitigation: reverted selector on canary; next steps: telemetry + selector update.

matt: I'll start a CV: kernel-selector KV-aware design doc and cc eng-runtime + eng-ml. Thanks all for quick triage.

pilar: I'll follow up with a dashboard tweak to show A/B latency regressions by kernel type so future rollouts show this signal earlier.

jamie: perfect. closing thread. Great cross-team response.
